rules: The QR identifies the printer product and exact supported variant.
The QR establishes pending Smart Target identity only.
The QR does not contain scoring, mission, geometry, or session behavior.
The backend will resolve the identity when QR integration is separately approved.
Unknown, altered, deferred, or retired identities must fail visibly.

capabilities: UGO registration against visible printed geometry
Classification against visibly identifiable printed zones
Shot count and supported distribution presentation
Digital scoring using the product's scoring model

unsupportedCapabilityDeclaration.policy: Capabilities not supported by the printer's product are unavailable.
capabilities: Capabilities beyond visible and validated product features
Unprinted mission, course, timer, penalty, distance, firearm, caliber, or shot-count requirements
External organization endorsement, licensing, sanction, ranking, or classification claims
Automatic equivalence between physical product variants

validationRequirements: Product name, SKUs, printer identity, dimensions, and paper descriptions match the locked Founder specification.
Smart Target and variant identities are unique and versioned.
Product, Smart Target, variant, mission, QR, and session identities remain separate.
The QR strategy declares identity only and grants no runtime behavior.
The deferred variant cannot be treated as the launch variant.
Runtime execution remains unavailable until UGO observation is separately approved.
No target artwork, ATP, Target Page, SEC, QR route, scoring implementation, or session behavior is created by Phase 1.
